ns2:section.sectionText: Registration is restricted until students have been accepted into the program by the Study Abroad Office. See the following link for more information. http://app.studyabroad.illinois.edu/. This course runs the second eight weeks of the Fall semester, October 22, 2012 to December 12, 2012. The off campus component runs December 26, 2012 to January 11, 2013. Students will explore how historical and current global economic processes differently transform public spaces in Cape Town?s rich, white urban center compared to those in its poor, black peri-urban townships.
